cpt_danger_report.overall_summary: The strongest plausible refinement candidates are concentrated on the physical/program-to-diagnosis path rather than on the many local LPTN chain CPTs. Root_Causes is the most suspicious because failure-only activations repeatedly select Memory_Corruption at the final decision stage. GPTN_5 and Physical_Anomaly form a strongly failure-associated physical branch whose calibration may be suboptimal, while GPTN_3, Program_Anomaly, and Execution_Integrity form a program-compromise branch that may overcommit to compromise states. By contrast, the numerous local response/dispatch CPTs and Network_Manipulation candidates appear more mixed, more upstream-dependent, or too weakly separated from successes to prioritize at this stage.
